$comment: The event-loop volume alert. Its insight query is GENERATED from the catalog's budget_per_user_day by scripts/ci/analytics.py: each row is one (event, distinct_id, IST day) and budget_used = events / that event's budget, so the alert fires when any user exceeded any event's own budget. `mise analytics:check` fails when the live insight or alert differs from what the catalog generates; `python3 scripts/ci/analytics.py sync-loop-alert --apply` makes them match. Events the catalog does not budget ($pageview, $exception, an off-catalog name) get 1000 a day (2.5x the 30-day max of 388 outside one 563-click power-user day), so an SDK storm still alerts. $ai_* trace events are excluded: their volume scales with agent depth, not with a repeating action (legitimate users reach 11k $ai_span a day).

insight.name: Health: events per (event, distinct_id, IST day) against the catalog budget (loop detector)
insight.description: Each (event, distinct_id, IST day) since yesterday that went over its daily budget: budget_used = events / budget_per_user_day from the event catalog. Uncatalogued events use the fallback in config/posthog/loop-alert.json; $ai_* traces are excluded. Generated by scripts/ci/analytics.py: change a budget in the catalog, never this query.

alert.name: Event loop: one distinct_id exceeded an event's daily budget
